title: Google Pixel 11 in for review
description: Last year was a big step for the Pixel 10, which gained a zoom camera (but downgraded the main camera), but this year, Google is keeping things simpler (and less innovative). The Google Pixel 11 is a straightforward yearly specs update. It keeps the body mostly unchanged; the screen is the same 6.3-incher, the battery is more or less the same, and so is the charging. What is new is the chipset - the 3nm Tensor G6, and the main camera, which packs a larger 1/1.56-inch main sensor (vs 1/2.0-inch on the Pixel 10), bringing it closer to the Pixel 9's 1/1.31-inch main unit. title: Google Keep's 'Find in note' search feature rolling out for Android users
description: Last year, Google began working on a feature called "Find in note" for Google Keep on Android, which lets users search within notes. The feature is now rolling out to all Google Keep users on Android. To search within a note in Google Keep, open the note, tap the three-dot menu button in the bottom-right corner, tap on the "Find in note" option, and enter what you want to find. Your search term will appear highlighted in yellow throughout the note. It's similar to pressing Ctrl+F on a PC.
